ChatbotRagContentPingURL.description: URL to ping when content updates.

ChatbotRagContentNamespaces.description: Namespaces to notify about changes in

ChatbotRagContentArticleTypeBlocklist.description: Array of article types not included in content updates

ChatbotRagContentTitleAllowlist.description: Array of page titles that should be included in content updates, overriding namespace restrictions

ChatbotRagContentPingImmediateRetries.description: Extra pingback attempts made inside a single job run when the endpoint answers with a retriable status. Costs nothing from the job queue, so it works even where queued retries do not.

ChatbotRagContentPingImmediateRetryDelay.description: Seconds to pause between the in-run pingback attempts.

ChatbotRagContentPingRetryDelays.description: Backoff, in seconds, before each queued retry of a failed pingback. Each delay is jittered by ±10% so that pingbacks failed by one outage do not all retry on the same second. The number of entries is the retry ceiling; an empty array disables queued retries.
